recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless the Security work group reopens the AuditEvent.agent.who cardinality decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32449 asked that AuditEvent.agent provide an expectation that who is specified; the final resolution was to make .agent.who 1..1.
initial_application: Commit bec1d701ba454ae67272bf872f5449669b6ce8a6 explicitly applied FHIR-32449 by changing AuditEvent.agent.who min from 0 to 1, and current blame still attributes the active min line to that commit.

reconciliation: No source change was made because source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml already defines AuditEvent.agent.who as Reference 1..1, and the checked AuditEvent examples each have exactly one who per agent.
